name: Hotel D'Meadows Ladakh Restaurant
why_it_matters: The only fully centrally-heated hotel in Drass and the closest thing the town has to a year-round restaurant. The 45-room property's multi-cuisine kitchen is the default sit-down meal for war-memorial visitors and Srinagar-Leh convoys.
insider_tip: Non-residents can walk in for lunch — the lachha paratha and malai kofta combo is what regulars order. Pizza takes 25 minutes from a cold start, so call ahead on 8899912311 if you're racing daylight to Kargil.
signature_address: Drass Main Market, NH1, Drass, Kargil District, Ladakh 194102

name: White Mountain View Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Highway-side multi-cuisine kitchen on NH1D that catches Srinagar-Leh traffic for breakfast and lunch. One of a handful of Drass kitchens with a posted menu rather than a verbal one.
insider_tip: Veg thali is the safest order on a long highway day — quickly assembled, generously portioned. Skip the Chinese; the kitchen does north-Indian and Kashmiri staples better.
signature_address: NH1D, Drass Main Market, Drass, Kargil District, Ladakh 194102

name: Cafe Rendezvous (Kargil War Memorial Cafeteria)
why_it_matters: Indian Army-run cafeteria inside the Kargil War Memorial complex — the open-air refreshment stand beside the souvenir counter. The samosa-and-chai stop most NH1D travellers take after the memorial walk.
insider_tip: Open seasonally — June to October only, until 7pm — and shut the rest of the year when Zoji La closes. Cash only; no menu, just a counter.
signature_address: Kargil War Memorial, NH1D, Drass, Kargil District, Ladakh 194102

name: Mushkoo Valley Guest House Restaurant
why_it_matters: Family-run guest house kitchen on the west side of Drass that takes walk-ins. One of the few options when D'Meadows is full or shut, and the closest place to the route towards Mushkoo Valley.
insider_tip: Wi-Fi doesn't work — load offline maps before you sit down. Order is verbal; rajma-rice and paratha-egg are the consistent picks.
signature_address: Mushkoo Valley Guest House, Drass, Kargil District, Ladakh 194102

name: Hotel Hill View Restaurant
why_it_matters: Bed-and-breakfast on Drass Market opposite the Ladakh tourism complex, with a small in-house kitchen serving residents and walk-ins. Useful when the bazaar's bigger restaurants are saturated by convoy traffic.
insider_tip: Breakfast is the strongest meal — eggs and paratha cooked to order. Confirm dinner availability by 6pm; off-season the kitchen winds down early.
signature_address: Drass Market, opposite Ladakh Tourism Complex, Drass 194102

name: Drass Guest House Hotel and Restaurant
why_it_matters: Long-running guest-house kitchen near Jamia Masjid in central Drass. One of the few places in town where buff momos and thukpa appear alongside Kashmiri pulao — the kitchen's range reflects the Kashmir-Balti-Ladakhi crossover that defines Drass food.
insider_tip: The momo chutney is the signature — locals call it the meal-maker. Cash only; the kitchen runs on a small staff so plan a 20-minute sit-down rather than a quick highway grab.
signature_address: Opposite Markazi Hanfia, near Jamia Masjid, Drass, Kargil District, Ladakh 194102
